nodes.label: Consent-Bound Support Access
nodes.rationale: Tenant administrators grant time-bounded metadata_health or diagnostic_bundle scopes with reason, ticket, and expiry; diagnostic access recomputes the redacted bundle and fails closed on any difference from the approved preview hash. There is no silent impersonation and no support role can approve or execute a remote action.

nodes.label: Dual-Approval Break Glass
nodes.rationale: Limited to metadata health, expires within one hour, requires two different support approvers, alerts the tenant on grant, is fully audited, and never unlocks diagnostics or remote actions; used only when waiting for ordinary consent would materially increase harm.

nodes.label: Enterprise Identity (OIDC/SAML/SCIM)
nodes.rationale: SCIM bearer secrets are shown once and stored as salted scrypt hashes with a deployment pepper; OIDC/SAML setup requires a verified DNS TXT challenge, an email domain alone never authorizes a role, deprovisioning is soft and preserves audit, and hosted startup rejects the checked-in deterministic test adapters.
